core_obligations: Easy direction (proof lines 1192-1208): if Box A is in Gamma and the inverse image of Gamma sits inside Delta, then A is a member of that inverse image, hence of Delta - a one-move unfolding of the definition.

Contrapositive direction (lines 1241-1251): assume Box A misses Gamma; deductive closure turns that into non-derivability; box2 pushes it to the inverse image failing to prove A; the consistency fact makes the inverse image plus not-A consistent; Lindenbaum produces a complete Delta covering the inverse image yet omitting A - the accessible world refuting necessity.
proof_roadmap: Read the forward inclusion off the inverse-image definition.
For the hard half, build the witnessing world from the failed derivation.
